title: Red-team CALIBRATION + silent-failure tooling (C11)
method: Adversarial probes with clearly-labeled SYNTHETIC fixtures against packages/swing-lab (calibration.ts, coverageRisk.ts, silentFailure.ts, cascadeWaterfall.ts) and packages/evaluation (metrics.ts). Every break reproduced by a probe first, then fixed, then locked with a regression test. Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 untouched. No Mac/iPhone/coach/Mobbin/pose/canonical-run evidence used or claimed.

breaks.break: NaN confidence leaked: NaN samples silently vanished from reliability bins while still inflating the ECE denominator, deflating ECE; Infinity landed in the last bin. Range check `c < 0 || c > 1` is false for NaN.
breaks.fix: assertValidConfidence(): Number.isFinite + [0,1] enforced in reliabilityBins, expectedCalibrationError, and coverage-risk entry points.

breaks.break: expectedCalibrationError([]) returned 0 — an empty dataset printed as perfectly calibrated.
breaks.fix: Raw ECE now throws on empty input; guarded calibrationReport() returns ece: null with an explicit flag instead.

breaks.break: Tiny-n ECE printed a confident bare number with no n disclosed (W14 datasets are n=12 TA verdicts and n=31 ownership boxes).
breaks.fix: calibrationReport() with ECE_MIN_SAMPLES=10 floor: always reports n, refuses (ece: null) below the floor with a flag; coverageRisk.ts report/console now emit the guarded report and never a bare ECE when refused. n=12/n=31 remain caveated as annotator self-report vs inter-annotator proxy, not model gold.

breaks.break: Degenerate confidence distributions (all 1.0, all equal) produced an unflagged, meaningless-looking-precise ECE.
breaks.fix: calibrationReport() flags degenerate all-equal / all-1.0 distributions; healthy spreads unflagged.

breaks.break: Zero-abstention coverage-risk curve: probed for degenerate output; behavior was actually sound (single full-coverage point, AURC = risk at that point) but unvalidated and untested, and NaN confidence could serialize to null in the JSON report.
breaks.fix: Input validation added; behavior locked with explicit regression tests for the zero-abstention shape and AURC identity.
breaks.status: FIXED (validation + tests; curve math itself was correct)

breaks.break: NaN/Infinity in gold (contactMs, event bounds), predictions (estimatedContactMs, targetCoverage) or degenerate gold spans (end <= start) produced confident correct/silent_failure verdicts from comparisons that are vacuously false on NaN.
breaks.fix: Finite guards on all compared quantities; non-finite inputs now yield status 'unverifiable' with disclosure. Exception kept deliberately: a RENDERED timeline with a non-finite boundary stays 'silent_failure' — a physically false user-visible render is a confident wrong claim.

breaks.break: Disputed gold silently counted either way: C05 filed a dispute against the 21604ms contact in wavea-944403-dink (CFR review observed the later 22122-22139ms scoop instead), yet silent-failure-v1 would count a claim against that value as confidently correct or confidently wrong.
breaks.fix: Re-versioned to silent-failure-v1.1 (silent-failure-v1 object left byte-identical; contract never weakened in place). New status 'excluded_disputed_gold': disputed contact/stroke gold is excluded-and-disclosed, counted neither as correct nor silent failure nor answered; a disputed contact also cannot rescue the EVENT claim via the contact-inside arm. The disputed annotation record was kept append-only and marked contactDisputed:true with contactDisputeRef pointing at datasets/experiments/wave-c/c05-summary.json. cascadeWaterfall now passes dispute flags through and declares v1.1.
breaks.regressionTest: packages/swing-lab/test/silentFailure.test.ts (v1 untouched, exclude-and-disclose, no rescue, undisputed behavior unchanged)

breaks.break: Same class of holes in packages/evaluation calibrationReport(): accepted NaN/out-of-range confidence, and reported ECE for empty/tiny-n/degenerate inputs without n or any warning.
breaks.fix: Finite+range validation (throws), report now carries n and warnings[] (empty, below CALIBRATION_MIN_SAMPLES=10 floor, all-equal degeneracy); numeric ECE kept for compatibility but disclosed as unstable when warned.

coverageDeltaNote: No fix uses blanket abstention. silent-failure-v1.1 changes verdicts ONLY for (a) disputed gold (exactly one committed record: the 21604ms contact in wavea-944403-dink) and (b) non-finite/degenerate inputs, of which the committed corpus contains zero (propertyInvariants corpus check: 305 files, 0 violations). All undisputed, well-formed gold evaluates byte-identically to v1 (regression-tested). Calibration fixes change reporting/disclosure only, never the underlying accepted/abstained decisions, so committed-positive-gold coverage is unchanged: delta = 0.
